known.via: English Wikipedia "Mt. Veeder AVA" (redirects to "Mount Veeder AVA")

climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Napa Valley AVA in Napa County, high in the southern Mayacamas Mountains, with steep vineyards on thin volcanic soil. Cabernet Sauvignon from here often shows briary flavors, moderate to bold tannins and herbal, floral aromas, in wines of powerful structure.
